summary: Refuse local VM operations when another domain's qcow2 external data file aliases an owned disk.

guide.reason: This tightens an existing fail-closed storage ownership check and adds no operator workflow.

api.reason: The existing host-side VM operations now refuse a foreign domain whose qcow2 external data file aliases an owned image. Request and response shapes are unchanged.

roadmap.reason: This is a focused correctness fix within the existing disk exclusivity safety gate.

state.reason: The fix changes only validation of qemu-img metadata during an existing ownership check; it adds no durable state.

verification.method: The new regression failed before the fix because exclusiveDisk returned nil for a foreign qcow2 whose format-specific data-file named the owned disk. The focused external-data, omitted-backing, and valid-foreign-raw tests passed after the fix. `go test -race ./internal/vmhost` and `go test ./internal/agent` passed.
